basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old biochemistry graduate from Warsaw, Poland, currently working as a research assistant in a pharmaceutical company. My interests include exploring new scientific discoveries, particularly in biochemistry and pharmacology, and I have a soft spot for dogs, often volunteering at local shelters. I’m engaged to my long-time partner, and we enjoy spending our weekends hiking and discovering new trails with our dog. I usually browse Reddit during my commute and late evenings. Although I've been on Reddit for just a few months, I've found it to be a great platform to connect with like-minded individuals and gain new insights. I dislike negativity and online trolling, and I strive to maintain a positive and supportive presence online.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong academic background in biochemistry, having earned my degree from the University of Warsaw. My knowledge is further enriched by my current role in a research lab, where I am involved in various projects related to drug development. I am also an avid reader of scientific journals and enjoy self-teaching new concepts that pique my interest.
